entities.name: Query kynureninase
observations: 430 aa soluble enzyme; predicted molecular weight 45.48 kDa and pI 5.09.
Contains Pfam Aminotran_5 (PF00266.26; residues 77-319) and KYNU_C (PF22580.3; residues 302-391).
Sequence is homologous to curated bacterial kynureninases, with 45.7-49.1% identity and 88.4-90.0% query coverage.

Best-supported functional assignment is pyridoxal 5'-phosphate-dependent kynureninase; exact substrate specificity is inferred from homologs, not directly experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: Q9RYH5 kynureninase
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Deinococcus radiodurans; EC 3.7.1.3.
Catalyzes cleavage of L-kynurenine and L-3-hydroxykynurenine using pyridoxal 5'-phosphate.
Curated reaction products are anthranilate plus L-alanine, or 3-hydroxyanthranilate plus L-alanine, respectively.

entities.name: L-kynurenine cleavage
observations: Rhea RHEA:16813: L-kynurenine + H2O = anthranilate + L-alanine + H(+).
Reaction is catalyzed by PLP-dependent kynureninase EC 3.7.1.3.

entities.name: 3-hydroxykynurenine cleavage
observations: This is the corresponding hydroxylated-substrate reaction of kynureninase EC 3.7.1.3.

entities.name: Pyridoxal 5-phosphate
observations: PLP is the required cofactor for the curated kynureninase homologs; the catalytic lysine forms the PLP-linked active-site intermediate.
